notes: Ubuntu-only browser selection update: Microsoft Edge Dev replaces Vivaldi as the fifth Multi-Browser candidate. Playwright uses the supported msedge-dev channel, and missing Edge Dev installations use the official Microsoft apt repository. Existing Vivaldi installations are left untouched. Retains browser setup progress, authentication timeout, cancellation, Single Browser mode, and up to 36 tabs across six compatible browsers. Windows and ChromeOS are unchanged.
